summary_markdown: The discussion covered the implementation of new filters (by weekend/by weekday, time granulation) for dashboard data. It was confirmed that these filters should be applied to the `/api/dashboard/airport/` endpoint. However, after questioning if this endpoint is used for an internal, non-public dashboard view, it was determined that since it is not shown to users, no changes are required for that specific endpoint.
decisions: Do not apply new filters (by weekend/by weekday, time granulation) to the `/api/dashboard/airport/` endpoint.
